value.rationale: Connected odd domination is independently motivated by the cited 2005 literature. The theorem settles the entire optimal and all-set structure for the natural infinite family of triangular/Johnson line graphs, including the exact count of all connected feasible subsets and a quadratic gap between connected and unrestricted optimal sizes for every odd n>=5. The forced split into two clique line graphs is a structural explanation, not a solitary normalization or small finite computation.
